erreurs.mot_de_passe: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.
erreurs.code: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
erreurs.different: The two passwords do not match.
erreurs.slug: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (3 to 50 characters).

cour.texte: Classes, attendance, report cards and Quran notebook in one place, for the staff and for families.
cour.pied_ue: Data hosted in the European Union

champs.aide_mot_de_passe: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.

connexion.intro: Sign in to get back to your daara.

inscription.intro: You will then create your daara, or join the one that invites you.

confirmation.intro: If this address can be used, a 6-digit code has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes.
confirmation.intro_email: Enter your address and the 6-digit code received by email. It is valid for 30 minutes.
confirmation.renvoye: If the address is awaiting confirmation, a new code has just been sent.
confirmation.indesirables: Nothing received? Check your spam folder.

oublie.intro: Enter your address: you will receive a code to choose a new password.
oublie.envoye: If an account exists for this address, a code has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes.
oublie.intro_mfa: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication: enter the code from your app to finish.

mfa.intro_enrolement: Required to manage a daara: it protects the data of students and families.
mfa.etape_application: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS…).
mfa.etape_scanner: Scan this QR code, or enter the key below.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.intro_verification: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.

erreurs.email_non_confirme: Your email address is not confirmed yet.
erreurs.mot_de_passe_faible: Password too weak: at least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.
erreurs.meme_mot_de_passe: Choose a password different from the old one.
erreurs.captcha: The anti-bot check failed. Try again.
erreurs.captcha_requis: Please wait for the anti-bot check.
erreurs.captcha_chargement: The anti-bot check could not load. Check your connection, then reload the page.
erreurs.trop_de_tentatives: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
erreurs.mfa_requise: First confirm with your authenticator app.
erreurs.session_expiree: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
erreurs.reseau: Cannot reach the server. Check your Internet connection.
erreurs.inattendue: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

onboarding.intro: You will be its administrator. Everything can be changed later in the settings.
onboarding.intro_securite: Before creating your daara, protect your account: two-factor authentication is required for administrators.

erreurs.slug_pris: This address is already taken: choose another one.
erreurs.donnee_invalide: Some information is invalid or reserved: check the name and the address.
erreurs.limite: You have reached the limit of 3 daaras created.
erreurs.aal2: Two-factor authentication is required to create a daara.
erreurs.inattendue: The daara could not be created. Try again.

franco_arabe.description: Classes, grades, report cards, attendance and Quran.

coranique.description: Quran notebook, recitations, nafar and attendance, without grades or report cards.

profil.aide_prerequis: Modules required by your choice will be added automatically.
profil.modifiable: Can be changed at any time in Settings → Modules.

navigation.daara_inaccessible: This daara is not accessible with your account.
navigation.acces_refuse: This page is not accessible with your role.
navigation.module_inactif: This module is not enabled in this daara.

select_daara.intro: You are a member of several daaras. You can switch at any time from the menu.

structure.description: Years, terms, classes, subjects and assigned teachers.

absences.description: Daily roll call, justifications and alerts to parents.

bulletins.description: Calculation, ranking, PDF report cards and publication to families.

coran_cahier.description: Tracking of the 114 surahs for each student, and homework.

coran_recitations.description: Recording of recitations and correction by the teacher.

coran_nafar.description: Quran revision schedule for each student.

notifications.description: Notifications and weekly reports to parents.

modules.intro: Enable the modules your daara uses: the others disappear for all members. Disabling a module deletes no data.
modules.prerequis_actives: {{module}} is enabled, with what it requires: {{prerequis}}.
modules.desactiver_message: The module will disappear for all members of the daara. Its data is kept and will come back if you enable it again.

erreurs.droits: Only an administrator who confirmed their identity can change the modules.
erreurs.inattendue: The modules could not be saved. Try again.
